Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 19

“Whoever thinks this one a slayer and whoever thinks it slain — neither of them understands. It does not slay, nor is it slain.”

Both the killer's pride and the mourner's horror rest on the same mistake. Krishna dismantles them together, which matters because Arjuna is currently the mourner and dreads becoming the killer.
